title: Results
intro: How well the broadcast tracking works, then every model result. A value with no interval says it is a point estimate. Each report links to its file.

scorecard.title: Tracking scorecard
scorecard.caption: Targets and results of build {build}, by game

paired.title: Paired differences between builds
paired.caption: Paired change on the observations both builds score
paired.note: A difference above zero means the build does better than the baseline.

scorecard.intro: Each row is a target set before the work started. The status is the one the scorecard file states.

models.title: Model results
models.caption: Every model, with its out-of-fold and held-out values and its verdict
models.question: Question

pending.title: No result yet
pending.intro: These reports hold no result yet, so no number from them is shown.

models.intro: Every model with a held-out test was tested on games it never saw. A model with no held-out test says so in its row. Failed and inconclusive models stay in the table.
